mapper.select: select f.id, f.family_member_id, f.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.create_by, f.update_by, f.remark from family_member_elder f left join elder e on f.elder_id = e.id where f.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} order by f.id desc

select f.id, f.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, e.sex, e.status, e.bed_number, c.nursing_level_name, timestampdiff(year, str_to_date(e.birthday, '%Y-%m-%d'), curdate()) as age from family_member_elder f left join elder e on f.elder_id = e.id left join check_in c on c.elder_id = e.id and c.status = 0 where f.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} order by f.id desc
